_meta.description: 100 recipes from data/recipes.db (ingredient names as stored), hand-labelled.
_meta.sampling: 40 recipes targeted at tricky terms (one or two per term), 60 uniformly random; recipes with 3-14 ingredients; random.Random(20261124).
_meta.labelling: Each of the 397 unique ingredient names was read and labelled by hand before the new rules were written. Recipe labels are the union over its ingredients. 'contains' = the usual US retail form contains the allergen; 'may_contain' = common formulations do, or cross-contact is common (oats -> gluten, chocolate chips -> dairy/soy). Coconut is not treated as a tree nut. Shellfish includes molluscs. Generic 'broth' counts as non-vegetarian.
